content: Next.js Server Actions default to a 1MB request body limit (configurable via experimental.serverActions.bodySizeLimit). Vercel enforces a hard 4.5MB request-body limit on standard serverless Functions regardless of framework config (Hobby plan included) - streaming/Edge functions bypass this. File exports needing custom headers (Content-Disposition) must use a Route Handler, not a Server Action, since Server Actions can't return raw Response objects.
